paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of accuracy between two methods across four benchmark datasets, titled "DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B Comparison." The horizontal axis contains the categories, displaying four distinct benchmark labels—GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC—which are not sorted in a specific alphabetical or value-based order. The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with numeric tick marks and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines spaced at regular intervals of 20. The data is presented using grouped vertical bars, where each category features a pair of side-by-side bars. According to the top-center legend, the light yellow bars represent "Vanilla CoT" (positioned on the left of each group) and the green bars represent "TLDR (Ours)" (positioned on the right). Within each pair, the light yellow "Vanilla CoT" bar is annotated with its exact absolute numeric value in black text above it. The adjacent green "TLDR (Ours)" bar is visually emphasized with an annotated relative percentage difference above it, colored red for negative values and green for positive values. For the GSM8K category, the yellow bar represents the tallest overall value in the chart at 92.5, with its corresponding green bar annotated "-1.6%". For MATH500, the yellow bar is labeled 86.4, accompanied by a green bar annotated "+0.2%". The AIME category contains the shortest bars in the chart, featuring a yellow bar at 43.4 and a green bar annotated "-0.1%". Finally, in the AMC category, the yellow bar is labeled 79.6, and the paired green bar is annotated "+3.9%".
